title: Employ only licensed casino staff
what: As the casino licensee or operator, employ people as casino key employees or casino employees only if they hold the matching licence.

laws.title: Casino Control (Burswood Island) (Licensing of Employees) Regulations 1985 (WA)

sources.title: Casino Control (Burswood Island) (Licensing of Employees) Regulations 1985 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Neither the holder of the Casino Gaming Licence, nor the Operator, shall employ a person, or permit a person to be employed or to work, in the Casino — (a) as a casino key employee, if that person is not the current holder of a casino key employee licence

administration.note: The Chief Casino Officer recommends whether an application for a licence is granted.
